slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about demand satisfaction, warehouse inventory use, integrality, and fixed costs, but never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers allowed per truck.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is not a binding or relevant constraint, so no truck capacity limit is included in the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the maximum containers per truck, and the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any truck capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: No P0 or P1 hidden slots were unresolved when the agent stopped; only the P2 truck capacity detail was not explicitly asked.

summary: The agent clarified several core modeling choices and stopped with no unresolved P0/P1 issues, but it missed the P2 truck-capacity detail and silently omitted a truck capacity constraint.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
